answer: In epoch 137 a new key enters only if an established sponsor posts a 30 POA jade bond on its behalf. Every sponsor's keys hang in a public willow tree under its address, so graders can see which branches share a trunk. When a sponsored key's grade sinks to the nadir, zero for three epochs, its bond burns, and a trunk with two burned branches loses the right to sponsor. Honest sponsors back few keys and recover bonds after ten epochs. Sponsoring 250 filler keys burns 250 x 30 = 7,500 POA the attacker forfeits.
